name: smwgraphics-lizard-guy-practice-makes-purrfect-smilies
title: Lizard Guy & 'Practice Makes Purrfect' Smilies
description:
This unnamed lizard fella is a new player graphic for people running low on ideas (seriously, Mario goes to the Mall?).

Includes:
- GFX32 to replace Mario with a Pink Lizard.
- Customized GFX00 & GFX01. Feel free to replace the altered 'Nintendo Presents' Logo.
- Custom Overworld GFX (only Mario is edited).
- The only two GFX pages with Mario's blush. Why they needed two I will never know.

Not included:
- AA Batteries
- Custom Palette (how would I create a .pal file for a global palette?)
- Map16 pages ( . . . )
- Any sense of sanity.

Some assembly required.
